- Added the Elite guide for Ghommal’s hilt 4 at 1,100 points. Solo and group routes use the points you still need and can include unfinished achievements from any tier.
- The route checks real access and preparation using quests, skills, diary flags, boss kill counts, and observed supplies. Practice and private-instance instructions appear on the relevant task cards.
- Use **Confirmed available** when a requirement needs your input. You can review and undo it under **Checked requirements**. Medium, Hard, and Elite share the same account progress, skips, and preparation.
